messages:
Priya S: Quick capture from today's DR postmortem follow-up. We keep seeing same 3-signal combo: LB weight drift, missed snapshot, and cold-cache surge. Need clear owners + short timelines.
Marcus R: I'll take LB weight drift. Plan: audit weight-sync job and add a checksum guard. ETA Mon EOD.
Dara N: I'll own snapshots. Action: validate last 14 daily snapshots for ap-south and eu-west, add alert when two consecutive cycles fail. ETA Tue AM.
Ellie H: I'll prototype a soft-warm prefill for hot prefixes to reduce cold-cache spikes. ETA Wed.
Priya S: Also need a cold-restore dry-run in eu-west (we only tested warm). Who can coord infra window?
Marcus R: I can coordinate the dry-run. Prefer Tue 03:00-05:00 UTC. Need infra for LB weight override and a perms ticket. Filing now.
Dara N: Found a lambda timeout overlap with backup compaction; I'll add 20% jitter and bump timeout to 15m. Also add manifest checksum probe.
Ellie H: Prefill job will include rate limiter and a kill switch. I'll add dashboard panels for prefill throughput and error rate.
oncall-bot: Reminder: add these owners to the continuity action tracker within 48h.
Priya S: Recap for tracker: Marcus (LB audit + dry-run coord)  Mon/Tue; Dara (snapshots + alerts)  Tue AM; Ellie (prefill + dashboards)  Wed. I'll schedule a 30-min triage next Tue to decide on permanent mitigations (autosync job, retention enforcement, warming job).
Marcus R: Blocking: need LB config read access. Ticket submitted.
Dara N: Will open pager rule when alert condition defined.
Priya S: Thanks all, I'll update tracker and ping infra after perms land. :thumbsup:
